verdict.rationale: Claude Design is a SaaS design product, so publishing an official MCP server for external agents is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence documents such a server. The PenPot flow (comm-7) uses PenPot's MCP server, which is client-side use and not a Claude Design server. The Claude Code /design-sync and /design integrations are first-party commands, and nothing shows them exposed as an MCP server.
